newsitem.title: USA: National Auto sees class action settlement.
newsitem.headline: National Auto sees class action settlement.

text.p: National Auto Credit Inc said Wednesday it agreed to pay $5.4 million in damages, penalties and interest related to a previously disclosed class action lawsuit.
The suit involved alleged violations by its discontinued auto rental business of certain California labor laws, including those relating to the payment of overtime.
The settlement is subject to approval by the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California at a fairness hearing to be heard November 21, the company said.
